name: threadhub-sandbox
description: Isolated public 'Try It' sandbox Worker + SandboxDO. Reuses ../threadhub (hub.js/view.js/publication.js/verify-standalone.mjs) as libraries, but with its OWN trigger-free store variant, DO class, and instance name. Shares NO state with the production hub (hub-prod). Ephemeral: a DO alarm sweeps threads older than 24h.
